region_scene_page.compact: The core 1960s UK beat-group road where British bands reframe American roots music as self-contained pop-rock.
region_scene_page.standard: Beatlemania opened the U.S. door, but the lane includes multiple UK answers: Beatles melodic craft, Stones blues bite, Who mod force, Animals R&B drama, Yardbirds guitar escalation, and Hollies/Searchers harmony.
